surface.description: What a dependent can read of a package: its whole source but its tests, SQL, docs and scratch, which nothing imports. A package's checks wait on its dependencies' surface, not their whole source, so a commit that changes only a dependency's tests, migration SQL or docs re-checks nothing downstream. The build waits on the whole source.

typecheck.description: Every project checks its own sources with --noEmit and reads its dependencies' sources directly, so no check waits on another's, and reruns when a package it loads changes, the submodule's grizzle packages among them; grizzle's packages keep their own gates. It is incremental: each project keeps its state in its own node_modules/.cache, which is no output (a replay restores none, and the checker compares each file's hash with what it holds), so a rerun rechecks only what changed. `pnpm check:full`, which the push gate runs once a day, runs it from scratch, `-- --incremental false`, which turbo hashes apart, so build info's open stale-result bugs (TypeScript #64386, #64591) live a day at most.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin and den's toolchain.config.ts are inputs too. Type-aware lint reads the types a package imports, so it waits on its dependencies' surface, as typecheck does.

load.description: toolchain-test load: every test module a package's runner config includes loaded apart, each in a process of its own under the runner's flags, failing on one that throws as it loads (a const read in its temporal dead zone, an initializer that throws, an export that is no property). Uncached by turbo: toolchain-test keeps each module's pass by its closure hash, so a check loads only what changed.

test.description: Every package's searches, through Vitest. Each run draws a fresh rotating seed, so a run never replays from cache, and the run's seed, a replay token and `pnpm fuzz`'s suite and fuzz time come through the environment.

//#workspace-gate.description: The toolchain's repository-wide checks: every tsconfig's Effect plugin block and diagnostics and the tree's file names, read as JSON and git's file list, never a TypeScript program. Uncached: it reads the whole tree in about a second, which a cache would have to hash.

//#dedupe.description: pnpm dedupe --check reads the manifests, the lockfile, the workspace file and .npmrc, never source.
